name: business-operations-console
//overrides: Build-tooling transitives with no direct dependent to bump — every dependent range still resolves to a vulnerable patch. All reach us only through vite/vitest/jsdom/eslint, none ship in the browser bundle. brace-expansion 5.0.9 is a deliberate cross-major force on eslint's 1.x copies — verified against eslint, tsc, 439 tests and the production build. Unlike cdk's, every copy here is reachable by this override, so none needs suppressing. nanoid 3.3.18 is the weakest entry here and is listed to keep `npm audit` readable, not to close an exposure: it arrives through postcss (via vite), and postcss requires `nanoid/non-secure`, a separate file that exports none of the CVE's customRandom/customAlphabet and whose loop exits at size 0 — the vulnerable code is never loaded, and the one call site passes the literal 6. source-map-js 1.2.2 fixes an event-loop DoS in indexed source-map parsing; it is a build-time transitive of postcss and css-tree, and was installed past the 7-day release-age cooldown deliberately as a security patch.
